verdict.rationale: The H200 SXM is a data-center GPU, a hardware accelerator with no user-facing interface, so a built-in AI assistant you delegate tasks to is a category error for this kind of product. The bundled software (AI Enterprise, NIM microservices, CUDA tools, inference endpoints) consists of developer building blocks for deploying AI. None of it is an in-product assistant, so it does not make the axis applicable.
